dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you often drink tea here?

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: Komore Teahouse is classy, has a fascinating view and is very cautious in choosing its guests. It is the best place for me to relax.

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: Walking around in the yard, watching the scenery and listening in to the chitchat of the guests are my favorite pastimes.

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: I have felt that I am being watched by somebody lately. It does creep me out...

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: But since I am already inside Komore Teahouse, I suppose I will be fine...
